notes.title: Official release update
notes.notes:
[New Content]
 Quests after the ending
 Ability to revisit previous stages after the ending
 Special functionality when wearing body painting
 New body paintings
 Achievements

[Usability Improvements]
 Add notifications when obtaining items
 Add notifications when quests are updated
 Remove cooldown for tools
 Adjust mouse sensitivity
 Fix camera to avoid obstacles blocking the view

[Bug Fixes]
 Prevent falling through the map
 Fix NPC dialogue bugs
